_doc: Public REST endpoints of crypto exchanges for latency probes. kind: time (server time, best: never cached, tiny), status, ticker (one market), markets (heavier), host (no known public endpoint: only DNS/TCP/TLS are meaningful). verified: the endpoint answered 2xx JSON from the checking node; blocked: it answered this HTTP status there (geo-block or WAF), so it exists but must be checked from elsewhere.
